title: Malleus Monstrorum
note: Statblokkene er hentet maskinelt ut av en OCR-konvertering av boka. Sjekk tall mot din egen utgave før du bruker dem i en viktig kamp — særlig angrepslinjer, som kan ha blitt delt feil.

creatures.name: Adumbrali
creatures.subtitle: Other-Dimensional Shadow Vampires
creatures.armor: none, but due to their shadowy nature the adumbrali are immune to all mundane weapons. Only enchanted weapons and spells which affect POW or INT can harm the adumbrate
creatures.spells: all know 1D3 spells, typically those which affect the mind
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D6 Sanity points to see the adumbrali

creatures.name: Aihais
creatures.subtitle: Martian Servants of Vulthoom
creatures.armor: none naturally, however some aihai clothes may afford 4point armor
creatures.spells: typically only a priest of Vulthoom will know spells. Those spells always include Contact Vulthoom, Create Gate, plus 1D3 others of the keeper's choice
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D8 Sanity points to see an aihai

creatures.name: Alskali
creatures.subtitle: Cyclopean Minions of the Nyarlathotep
creatures.armor: none
creatures.spells: known are generally those dealing with Nyarlathotep and his servants
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D6 Sanity points to see an alskali

creatures.name: Beings of Ib & Ghost-beings of Ib
creatures.subtitle: Servants of Bokrug Beings of Ib Ghost-Beings of Ib

attacks.name: Paw
attacks.damage: /damage 1D4 N/A POW Drain N/A POW vs. POW/ damage 1D3 POW

creatures.armor: none for the beings of Ib. The ghost-beings of Ib cannot be harmed in any physical way: spells which attack or drain POW or INT work against them
creatures.spells: any being of Ib with a POW of 14 or more may know up to 1D6 spells, always including Contact Bokrug. The ghost-beings of Ib have any spells known while living
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D6 Sanity points to see either a being of Ib or a ghost-being of Ib

creatures.name: Broodlings of Eihort
creatures.subtitle: Gestalt Servants of the God of the Labyrinth

attacks.name: Any at base%, damage as per weapon

creatures.armor: none. All physical attacks do minimum damage. If a broodling escapes with even a single hit point left it may fully regenerate. Regeneration takes 10 minutes per hit point to maximum original hit points. If reduced to zero hit points a broodling melts into a mass of wriggling white spiders. Once reduced to zero hit points a broodling may not regenerate
creatures.skills: most at a -10% penalty, due to their effort to pass as human
creatures.spells: a broodling of Eihort generally knows 1D4 spells. Known spells will deal with Eihort and similar entities
creatures.sanity_loss: no loss to see a broodling in perfect human form; once a broodling begins to melt down and reveal its true nature, 1/1D8 Sanity points

creatures.name: Byakhee
creatures.subtitle: the Star-Steeds
creatures.armor: 2-point fur and tough hide
creatures.spells: byakhees of POW 14 or more know at least 1D4 spells, normally spells relating to Hastur and associated beings
creatures.sanity_loss: 1/1D6 Sanity points to see a byakhee

creatures.name: Chakota
creatures.subtitle: Spirit of Many Faces

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.damage: 1D3 per face Wail of the Chakota automatic, damage 1/1D8 Sanity points (see above)

creatures.armor: the chakota is immune to physical weapons, but fire, magic, and electricity can harm it. If the mouths are covered it can suffocate in earth or water
creatures.spells: none
creatures.sanity_loss: 1D3/1D20 Sanity points to see a chakota

creatures.name: Chaugnar Faugn
creatures.subtitle: Vampiric Elephantine Horrors

attacks.name: Blood Sucker
attacks.damage: after Grapple & Bite, damage 1 hit point per round

creatures.armor: 2-point wrinkly elephantine skin
creatures.spells: Lesser brothers know no spells
creatures.sanity_loss: 1/1D4 Sanity points to see a lesser brother of Chaugnar Faugn

creatures.name: Children of the Green God
creatures.subtitle: Mutant Rabbit-Folk
creatures.armor: none
creatures.spells: a child of the Green God with a POW of 16 or more knows Contact The Green God and 1D6 other spells
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D4 Sanity points to see a child of the Green God

creatures.name: Children of the Wind
creatures.subtitle: Savage Apparitions
creatures.armor: their blubbery texture affords the children of the wind some protection against impaling weapons, which inflict only half damage upon the creatures. Magic and non-magic weapons inflict normal damage
creatures.spells: none, usually
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D6 Sanity points to see a child of the wind

creatures.name: Chthonian Full Adults
creatures.subtitle: Tentacled Burrowers
creatures.armor: 5-point hide and muscle; regenerates 5 hit points per round after wounded, but dies immediately upon reaching zero hit points. Water is lethal to chthonians (see above)
creatures.spells: a full adult possess spells if an INT x3 roll on 1D100 succeeds; it then has 1D6 spells connected with Shudde M'ell and Great Old Ones tied to this earth, such as Cthulhu, Y'golonac, Yig, etc
creatures.sanity_loss: 1D3/1D20 Sanity points for a full adult; 1/1D10 Sanity points for the lesser instars; no Sanity points to see a hatchling

creatures.name: Cold Ones
creatures.subtitle: Ylidheem
creatures.armor: none, however, cold ones are immune to all physical attacks. Fire harms them at a rate of 2D6 points of damage per successful strike with a torch, or as per fire-producing weapon/attack
creatures.skills: Dodge DEX x 2% (average 42%); Hide in Snow 90%; Sneak in Snow 90%
creatures.spells: a cold one with an INT of 16 or higher knows 1D3 spells, usually dealing with Aphoom Zhah, Rlim Shaikorth, cold, weather, etc
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D6 Sanity points to see a cold one; 0/1D3 Sanity points to hear the tortured shriek of a cold one

creatures.name: Colours Out of Space
creatures.subtitle: Life-Force Feeders
creatures.armor: none. Invulnerable to physical attack except by strong magnetic fields, which can imprison it. Vulnerable to magic
creatures.spells: none
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D4 Sanity points to see a colour; 1/1D8 Sanity points to see a victim of a colour

creatures.name: Crawling Ones
creatures.subtitle: Wormy Things

attacks.name: Various per base%, damage as per weapon

creatures.armor: none; however due to the soft and resilient quality of the crawling ones' bodies normal weapons do minimum damage to the things

creatures.name: Dark Ones
creatures.subtitle: The Strange Dark Folk

attacks.name: any weapon 75%, damage as per weapon

creatures.armor: none
creatures.skills: Ride 75%, Sneak 90%, and any number of appropriate skills
creatures.spells: none, but may possess strange artifacts to open Gates, to contact other Mythos beings, to invoke mist, winds, storms, etc., at the keeper's discretion. Humans generally cannot utilize the magic-like properties of the dark ones' artifacts
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D2 Sanity points to see a dark one, unless it has inhabited a body of someone the investigators know is dead, in which case he Sanity loss is 1/1D6+1 points. Host bodies in the later stages of decomposition may call for a Sanity loss of 1/1D8 or even 1/1D10 points

creatures.name: Dark Sargassum

attacks.name: Tentacle
attacks.damage: = db or catch (Grapple) Bite automatic when Grappled, 1D3

attacks.name: STR drain per round Crush Ship

creatures.armor: firearm attacks do only 1 point of damage. A firearms impale does 2 points of damage. Shotguns are exceptions, and do minimum possible damage, whatever that is. creatures.spells: a dark sargassum knows a number of appropriate spells equal to half its INT; round fractions up
creatures.sanity_loss: 1D6/1D20 Sanity points to see a dark sargassum

creatures.name: Daughters of Atlach-nacha
creatures.subtitle: Weavers of the Great Web

attacks.damage: 1D10 + venom (see above) Feast automatic when paralyzed, damage 1 INT devoured each round

creatures.armor: 5-points hard shell
creatures.spells: all daughters of Atlach-Nacha know both Contact and Call Atlach-Nacha. Daughters with INT scores of 15 or higher know 1D3 additional spells
creatures.sanity_loss: 1/1D8 Sanity points to see a daughter of Atlach-Nacha. Seeing a human molt into a daughter costs an additional 1/1D8 points of Sanity

creatures.name: Deep Ones

creatures.skills: Hide in Water 25%, Listen 30%, Sneak in Water 25%, Spot Hidden 30%
creatures.spells: at the discretion of the keeper, deep ones with POW 14 or more know at least 1D4 spells. Spells known always relate to Cthulhu, Dagon & Hydra, the star-spawn of Cthulhu, yuggs, and other horrors of the sea
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D6 Sanity points to see a deep one. D

creatures.name: Denizens of S'GLHUO
creatures.subtitle: Creatures of Living Sound Living Sound Form Reptilian Form
creatures.armor: none, however as living sound these creatures are immune to all physical damage. Certain spells which affect INT or POW harm them normally, as well as particularly discordant sounds, which are especially harmful to the denizens

creatures.name: Desh

creatures.armor: none none

creatures.name: Dholes & Bholes
creatures.subtitle: Burrowing Horrors
creatures.armor: points = the dhole's POW
creatures.spells: none
creatures.sanity_loss: 1D6/2D20 Sanity points to see a dhole or a bhole

creatures.name: Dimensional Shamblers
creatures.subtitle: the Murderously Malign

creatures.spells: a shambler knows one spell per point of INT over 9
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D10 Sanity points to see a dimensional shambler

creatures.name: Dreams
creatures.armor: none, but these creatures take damage only from enchanted weapons and magic which affects INT or POW
creatures.spells: if a guardian's INT is rolled on 1D100 or less, then it knows that many spells. These creatures have the unique ability of being able to cast Dreamlands spells in the waking world. If a guardian knows spells they are likely to be those of the Dreamlands
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D6 Sanity points to see a guardian

creatures.name: Dust-men
creatures.subtitle: SleepWalkers Dreamlands Waking World Dust-Man Dust-Man

attacks.name: Whirl

A successful attack to one of these creatures has a 10% chance of striking the brain-organ, thereby instantly killing it. Fire, electricity, and magic can inflict normal damage upon these creatures
creatures.spells: all know 2D6 spells. Known spells always relate to Cthulhu, deep ones, and other related aquatic horrors
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D8 Sanity points to see a dweller in the depths

creatures.armor: 7-point skin
creatures.spells: each has INT x3 chance to know 1D4 appropriate spells
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D6 Sanity points to see an elder thing

creatures.name: Fire Vampires
creatures.subtitle: the Flame Feeders
creatures.armor: most material weapons cannot harm them, including bullets, etc. Water costs a fire vampire one hit point per halfgallon poured over it, a typical hand-held fire extinguisher does 1D6 hit points of damage to it, and a bucket of sand costs it 1D3 hit points

creatures.spells: none

creatures.spells: roll 1D20. If the roll is higher than the polyp's INT, it knows no spells. Otherwise, the polyp knows a number of spells equal to the die roll. The kindly keeper chooses those that seem appropriate
creatures.sanity_loss: 1D3/1D20 Sanity points to see a flying polyp

creatures.spells: all fosterlings may Call their parent deity and Summon/Bind or Contact members of that deity's servant race, if any; those with INT know at least 1D6 other spells
creatures.sanity_loss: 1/1D10 Sanity points to see a fosterling of the Old Ones

creatures.name: Ghasts
creatures.subtitle: Unwholesome Scabrous Beasts
creatures.armor: 3-point thick skin
creatures.spells: none
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D8 Sanity points to see a ghast

creatures.name: Ghouls

creatures.armor: firearms and projectiles do half of rolled damage; round up any fraction
creatures.skills: Burrow 75%, Climb 85%, Hide 60%, Jump 75%, Listen 70%, Scent Decay 65%, Sneak 80%, Spot Hidden 50%
creatures.spells: roll 1D100 — if the roll is higher than the ghoul's INT, it knows no spells; if equal to or lower than INT, it may know that many spells, as chosen by the keeper. Ghouls generally do not use spells or magic
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D6 Sanity points to see a ghoul

creatures.name: Glaaki
creatures.subtitle: Decaying Slaves
creatures.armor: none
creatures.spells: retains any known when alive, plus any new spells taught by Glaaki
creatures.sanity_loss: no Sanity point loss if human-seeming; 1/1D8 Sanity points lost if in living-corpse aspect; if dead from Green Decay, 1/1D10 Sanity points to see

creatures.name: Gn'icht' Tyaacht

This latter acts as 5-point armor. They always adopt their thick skinned form when out of concealment, and thus can only be caught without armor if surprised when leaving or entering their trees, or when hidden
creatures.spells: none individually. See above for grove spells
creatures.sanity_loss: anyone seeing a single gn'icht' tyaacht must make a Sanity roll, losing 1D6 if the roll is failed. Seeing a gn'icht' tyaacht emerge from its tree has a greater penalty of 1/1D10 Sanity points

creatures.name: Gnoph-keh
creatures.subtitle: Legends of the Ice
creatures.armor: 9-point gristle, fur, and hide

creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D3 Sanity points to see a Goatswood gnome

creatures.name: Gof'nn Hupadgh Shub-niggurath

creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D4 Sanity points to see most gof'nn hupadgh ShubNiggurath—1/1D6 for really horrible mutations

creatures.name: Greater Brothers of Chaugnar Faugn

creatures.spells: Contact Chaugnar Faugn, Summon/Bind Lesser Brothers of Chaugnar Faugn, plus at least 1D10 others
creatures.sanity_loss: inert, a greater brother of Chaugnar Faugn costs 0/1D4 Sanity points to see; animated and active, it costs 1D3/1D8 Sanity points

creatures.name: Gyaa-yothn

creatures.spells: none
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D8 Sanity points to see a gyaa-yothn

A successful Dodge roll allows a victim to avoid the whip

creatures.spells: if the L'gy'hxian's INT or less is rolled on 1D100 it knows that many spells. Contact Lrogg is always among spells known
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D8 Sanity points to see an inhabitant of L'gy'hx

creatures.name: Martense Kin

creatures.sanity_loss: 1/1D8 Sanity points for seeing a Martian

creatures.sanity_loss: 1D6/1D20 Sanity points to see a spawn of Hastur

creatures.name: Spawn of Nyogtha
creatures.subtitle: Blasphemous Children of the Dark Monstrous Form Human Form

attacks.name: as per normal human in human form Claw (monstrous form) 65%, damage 1D6 + db Bite (monstrous form) 65%, damage 1D8 + db Grapple (monstrous form) 50%, damage special

creatures.armor: all spawn of Nyogtha, whether in human or monstrous form, are immune to bullets and weapons that impale, and take minimum possible damage from all other attacks. They are also immune to fire, acid, radioactivity, and electricity
creatures.spells: all spawn are given the Contact Nyogtha spell at puberty, and learn other spells easily. Once fully grown into their final monstrous forms the spawn know 2D6 spells related to Nyogtha and the other Great Old Ones
creatures.sanity_loss: none for a spawn still in human form. 0/1D3 Sanity points for seeing a human spawn ooze black ichor instead of blood. 1/1D10 Sanity points to see a spawn that has mutated into its final monstrous form

creatures.name: Spawn of Othuyeg
creatures.subtitle: Children of the Doom-Walker
creatures.armor: they suffer only minimal damage from impaling weapons
creatures.spells: Call Othuyeg. If a spawn's INT or less is rolled on 1D100 then it knows a number of other spells equal to 1/2 its INT
creatures.sanity_loss: 1D6/2D8 Sanity points to see the spawn of Othuyeg

creatures.name: Spawn of the Green Abyss
creatures.subtitle: Entrancing Entities of the Deep
creatures.armor: none, but the spawn of the Green Abyss are immune to normal weapons. Spells, enchanted weapons, fire, electricity, and chemicals harm them. The spawn of the Green Abyss regenerates 1D3 hit points per round until dead
creatures.spells: all have a chance equal to their INT or less on 1D100 to know 1D6 spells
creatures.sanity_loss: 1D6/1D20 Sanity points to see a spawn of the Green Abyss

creatures.name: Star-spawn of Cthulhu
creatures.subtitle: Xothans, Satraps of The Sleeper
creatures.armor: 10-point hide & blubber; regenerates 3 hit points per round
creatures.spells: each knows 3D6 spells
creatures.sanity_loss: 1D6/1D20 Sanity points to see a star-spawn

creatures.name: The Nagaae
creatures.subtitle: Servants of Cyaegha
creatures.armor: 2-point tough, leathery, translucent skin
creatures.skills: Hear Noise 60%, Slither Quietly 70%, Smell Victims 80%

creatures.name: Thralls of Cthulhu
creatures.subtitle: Servants of Cthulhu
creatures.armor: none; regenerates1D6 hit points per round. Thralls reduced to zero hit points through physical attack reform completely healed in 1D8+1 rounds. Thralls are most vulnerable to magical attack
creatures.skills: thralls retain most skills they had as humans, although skills cannot ever improve once they make the final transformation from human to thrall. Certain skills, such as Bargain, Climb, Credit Rating, Fast Talk, First Aid, Persuade, and Ride cannot ever be used again. Also: Listen Under Water 65%, Swim 65% (unless the thrall had a higher Swim as a human, in which case it retains the skill at that percentile)
creatures.spells: any known as human
creatures.sanity_loss: 1/1D8 Sanity points to see a thrall of Cthulhu

creatures.name: Vile Fungus
creatures.subtitle: alien parasite
creatures.armor: none, however firearms and other weapons inflict no damage on the fungus. Attacking the parasite with firearms or weapons only shreds and scatters the material, making accidental infection to anyone in the immediate area a dangerous possibility. Fire, chemicals and similar attacks are most effective on the alien fungus
creatures.spells: none
creatures.sanity_loss: 0/1D4 Sanity points to see vile fungus. Viewing a body that has been transformed by a fungus costs 1D3/1D8 Sanity points—1D4/1D10 if it is the body of someone known to the investigator
